name: Sputnik
description: Sputnik lamps: a ball at the hub, twelve rods of two lengths and a bead on every tip, each lamp turned and sized at random.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --t: rotate(@r(0deg, 30deg)) scale(@r(.7, 1.05)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--rods); clip-path: @var(--rods); transform: @var(--t); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: @var(--balls); mask: @var(--balls); transform: @var(--t); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --rods: polygon(95% 48.4%, 95% 51.6%, 55.97% 51.6%, 77.65% 64.11%, 76.05% 66.89%, 54.37% 54.37%, 73.89% 88.17%, 71.11% 89.77%, 51.6% 55.97%, 51.6% 81%, 48.4% 81%, 48.4% 55.97%, 28.89% 89.77%, 26.11% 88.17%, 45.63% 54.37%, 23.95% 66.89%, 22.35% 64.11%, 44.03% 51.6%, 5% 51.6%, 5% 48.4%, 44.03% 48.4%, 22.35% 35.89%, 23.95% 33.11%, 45.63% 45.63%, 26.11% 11.83%, 28.89% 10.23%, 48.4% 44.03%, 48.4% 19%, 51.6% 19%, 51.6% 44.03%, 71.11% 10.23%, 73.89% 11.83%, 54.37% 45.63%, 76.05% 33.11%, 77.65% 35.89%, 55.97% 48.4%); --balls: radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 99%, transparent 100%) 50% 50% / 26% 26% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 99%, transparent 100%) 100% 50% / 10% 10% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 99%, transparent 100%) 78.87% 66.67% / 7% 7% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 99%, transparent 100%) 75% 93.3% / 10% 10% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 99%, transparent 100%) 50% 83.33% / 7% 7% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 99%, transparent 100%) 25% 93.3% / 10% 10% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 99%, transparent 100%) 21.13% 66.67% / 7% 7% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 99%, transparent 100%) 0% 50% / 10% 10% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 99%, transparent 100%) 21.13% 33.33% / 7% 7% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 99%, transparent 100%) 25% 6.7% / 10% 10% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 99%, transparent 100%) 50% 16.67% / 7% 7% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 99%, transparent 100%) 75% 6.7% / 10% 10% no-repeat, radial-gradient(circle closest-side, #000 99%, transparent 100%) 78.87% 33.33% / 7% 7% no-repeat; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
